title: Get Geographic Place Resolution Request
description: Read-only query parameters for a geo-place resolver. Supply exactly one of q (unresolved human intent) or value (an existing identifier to refresh). Country is mandatory. Optional subdivision, place_type, system_version, and locale further constrain matching.

q.description: Unresolved place name or alias supplied by the user.

value.description: Existing identifier to look up in the requested/current catalog version for lifecycle refresh or replacement discovery. Mutually exclusive with q.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to disambiguate the query.

system_version.description: Optional exact supported catalog version to search.

locale.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag for returned labels.
